WR Concentric Internal Retaining Ring for Bore

A concentric-type internal (C-shape) retaining ring installed inside a bore. Unlike a standard C-type (R-type) ring, the ring itself is machined into a perfectly circular (concentric) shape, so once seated in the groove its center stays true and it distributes load evenly. The spec code is WR, conforming to the KS B 1338 (C-type concentric retaining ring) series of standards.

Notes

A thickness of t=1.6mm may currently be substituted with 1.5mm, in which case m becomes 1.65mm. The d1·d2·m·n values in the "Applicable Bore (Reference)" column are recommended dimensions, and the shape of the retaining ring's cut ends may differ from the drawing without issue.
